polls.support_text: 11.1 per cent strongly agreed and 55.2 per cent agreed; 4.2 per cent did not know or were unsure and 1.2 per cent declined to answer
polls.scope: Philippines, adults, nationally representative face-to-face sample
polls.question: There are proposals in Congress to impose a wealth tax on people with assets of PHP 1 billion and above. Do you agree or disagree with this proposal?
polls.question_original: May mga panukala sa Kongreso na magpataw ng “wealth tax” o buwis sa mga taong PHP 1 bilyon pataas ang ari-arian. Sang-ayon o hindi sang-ayon ka ba sa panukalang ito?
polls.sample: 1,487 face-to-face interviews, margin of error +/- 2.5 points
